category: Multiprinting partner / event & campaign print support

contact_person: Sophie Peiro, Key Account Customer Manager

category: Custom POS displays / metal displays / premium units
short_description: Propulzija is a design and production supplier specialized in custom POS displays, metal structures, premium display units and technical display solutions. It is suitable for more complex POS projects requiring design, engineering and production support.

category: Shop-in-Shop / branded retail concept / retail furniture

It is relevant when Sika needs a structured shop-in-shop concept, retail furniture or scalable in-store execution.
contact_person: HMY Poland: Mikolaj Luczynski / HMY Spain: To be completed by admin

short_description: Holbox is a specialist in cardboard-based POS and promotional activation materials, suitable for temporary displays, campaign activations and retail visibility materials.
notes: Cardboard POS and promotional activation specialist for retail. Do not route as a lightbox supplier.

short_description: Mobile Lightbox is a supplier focused on portable and flexible illuminated visibility solutions, suitable for mobile lightboxes and promotional visibility with lighting.
notes: Only visible MVP partner for lightbox / portable illuminated visibility.

short_description: Design4Retail is a premium retail design partner for state-of-the-art shop-in-shop concepts, branded retail experiences and shopper-focused in-store environments. It is suitable when Sika wants to explore a more differentiated, creative or next-level approach to retail execution.
recommended_for: Projects where Sika wants to try something different
notes: Use this partner when the objective is not only to produce standard POS material, but to explore a more differentiated, premium or next-level retail experience.
suggested_next_step: Use this partner when the objective is to try something different: a more differentiated, premium or next-level retail experience rather than standard POS execution.
